# [vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1)

## Overview

Tests for the `VK_EXT_multi_draw` extension commands `vkCmdDrawMultiEXT` and
`vkCmdDrawMultiIndexedEXT`. The file registers a `multi_draw` subgroup and builds a nested case matrix over mesh
layout, indexed/non-indexed command form, draw count, stride, instance count, shader stages, multiview, draw-ID use,
and indexed vertex-offset handling. Runtime verification compares integer color and stencil attachments with
CPU-generated references.

## Role of File

Implementation-heavy test file for the `multi_draw` subgroup. It contains the `MultiDrawTest` case class,
`MultiDrawInstance` execution logic, draw-info packing helpers, triangle generators, and the full registration loop for
multi-draw cases.

## Source Code

- Primary source: [vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1)
- Header: [vktDrawMultiExtTests.hpp](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.hpp#L1)
- Parent-category registration: [createChildren()](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawTests.cpp#L70)

## Registration Hierarchy

```text
draw.renderpass.multi_draw
├── mosaic
└── overlapping

draw.dynamic_rendering.primary_cmd_buff.multi_draw
├── mosaic
└── overlapping

draw.dynamic_rendering.partial_secondary_cmd_buff.multi_draw
└── mosaic (secondary-command-buffer reduced matrix)

draw.dynamic_rendering.complete_secondary_cmd_buff.multi_draw
└── mosaic (secondary-command-buffer reduced matrix)
```

The roots above are derived from the parent draw registration. The render-pass branch calls
[`createChildren()`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawTests.cpp#L132-L138) directly under `draw.renderpass`. The
dynamic-rendering branch first creates command-buffer mode groups and then calls
[`createChildren()`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawTests.cpp#L144-L177) under `primary_cmd_buff`,
`partial_secondary_cmd_buff`, and `complete_secondary_cmd_buff`. The parent source does not add `multi_draw` directly to
`draw.dynamic_rendering`; it adds dynamic-rendering children only after those mode groups are populated
([`vktDrawTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawTests.cpp#L193-L198)).

Nested dynamic-rendering command-buffer mode groups are intentionally absent from the tree because they set
`nestedSecondaryCmdBuffer=true` ([`vktDrawTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawTests.cpp#L178-L191)), while
[`createDrawMultiExtTests()`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawTests.cpp#L103-L104) is inside the enclosing
`!groupParams->nestedSecondaryCmdBuffer` branch
([`vktDrawTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawTests.cpp#L72-L121)).

The `multi_draw` group name is created by
[`createDrawMultiExtTests()`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1396-L1398). The direct children
shown in the tree come from `meshTypeCases` (`mosaic`, `overlapping`) and are added to the group in the outer
registration loop ([`vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1398-L1408),
[`vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1497-L1503),
[`vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1633)). Secondary-command-buffer
roots keep only `mosaic` at this level because the registration loop skips non-mosaic mesh types when
`useSecondaryCmdBuffer` is true
([`vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1499-L1501)).

## Test Families

### mosaic — per-pixel triangle mosaic

The `mosaic` subgroup uses `MeshType::MOSAIC` from the `meshTypeCases` table
([`vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1398-L1407)). Mosaic geometry is
generated by `TriangleMosaicGenerator`, which creates one small triangle per target pixel
([`vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L168-L209)); the test dimensions use
`getTriangleCount()` and a square framebuffer derived from that count
([`vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L823-L840)). This makes per-pixel
reference values sensitive to draw index, instance index, view index, and indexed-vertex ordering.

Direct draw-form children under `mosaic` are generated from `drawTypeCases`, `offsetTypeCases`, and the concatenated
`drawGroupName` logic ([`vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1410-L1424),
[`vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1505-L1525)):

- `normal` — non-indexed multi-draw via `vkCmdDrawMultiEXT`.
- `indexed_mixed` — indexed multi-draw with `VertexOffsetType::MIXED`.
- `indexed_random` — indexed multi-draw with `VertexOffsetType::CONSTANT_RANDOM`.
- `indexed_packed` — indexed multi-draw with `VertexOffsetType::CONSTANT_PACK`.

Below each draw-form group, the registration loop nests draw count, stride, instance, shader-stage, and multiview
groups before adding `no_offset` leaves and, for indexed draws, `offset_6` leaves
([`vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1426-L1493),
[`vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1527-L1611)). Each leaf can also
receive the `_no_draw_id` suffix from `drawIdCases` when the shader does not use draw-ID input
([`vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1464-L1467),
[`vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1603-L1610)).

### overlapping — depth-ordered full-screen triangles

The `overlapping` subgroup uses `MeshType::OVERLAPPING` from the same mesh table
([`vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1403-L1408)). Its geometry comes
from `TriangleOverlapGenerator`, which creates full-screen triangles with decreasing depth values from `0.75` toward
`0.25` ([`vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L211-L243)). This family
therefore stresses depth ordering across repeated multi-draw submissions while stencil output confirms draw coverage.

The draw-form children are the same `normal`, `indexed_mixed`, `indexed_random`, and `indexed_packed` groups described
for `mosaic`, but overlapping meshes skip instance-count cases greater than one
([`vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1582-L1585)). The test setup also
chooses the depth compare operation according to indexed vs non-indexed ordering
([`vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L910-L913)).

## Parameter Dimensions

| Parameter | Observed values and source |
|-----------|----------------------------|
| Mesh type | `mosaic`, `overlapping` from `meshTypeCases` ([source](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1398-L1408)) |
| Draw form | `normal`, `indexed_mixed`, `indexed_random`, `indexed_packed`; invalid normal-with-offset and indexed-without-offset combinations are skipped ([source](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1410-L1424), [skip logic](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1514-L1519)) |
| Draw count | `no_draws` = `0`, `one_draw` = `1`, `16_draws` = `16`, `max_draws` = `getTriangleCount()` ([source](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1426-L1433)) |
| Stride | `stride_zero`, `standard_stride`, `stride_extra_4`, `stride_extra_12`; nonzero stride derives from the relevant multi-draw info structure size plus the listed extra bytes ([source](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1435-L1442), [stride calculation](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1553-L1569)) |
| Instance parameters | `no_instances`, `1_instance`, `10_instances`, `2_instances_base_3` ([source](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1444-L1451)) |
| Shader stages | `vert_only`, `with_geom`, `with_tess`, `tess_geom` ([source](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1453-L1461)) |
| Draw ID | enabled by the empty suffix or disabled by `_no_draw_id` ([source](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1464-L1467)) |
| Multiview | `single_view`, `multiview` ([source](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1487-L1493)) |
| Leaf vertex offset | `no_offset` for all generated leaves and `offset_6` for indexed leaves ([source](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1603-L1611)) |

Dynamic-rendering secondary-command-buffer roots are a reduced matrix, not merely duplicate registrations. When
`groupParams->useSecondaryCmdBuffer` is true, the loop keeps only `mosaic` mesh cases, keeps offset-bearing indexed
cases only for `CONSTANT_RANDOM` while still permitting non-indexed `normal`, and keeps only `one_draw`
([`vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1499-L1501),
[`vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1509-L1512),
[`vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1529-L1531)).

## Support Requirements

- `VK_EXT_multi_draw` is required for every case
  ([`checkSupport()`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L423-L425)).
- `VK_KHR_shader_draw_parameters` is required when draw-ID input is used
  ([`checkSupport()`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L427-L428)).
- Tessellation and geometry shader core features are required only for the generated shader-stage variants that use
  them ([`checkSupport()`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L430-L434)).
- Multiview cases require `multiview`; combinations with tessellation or geometry also require
  `multiviewTessellationShader` or `multiviewGeometryShader`
  ([`checkSupport()`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L436-L447)).
- Dynamic-rendering registrations require `VK_KHR_dynamic_rendering`
  ([`checkSupport()`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L450-L451)).
- The whole `multi_draw` registration is Vulkan-only because the parent `createChildren()` call adds it inside the
  `#ifndef CTS_USES_VULKANSC` block ([`vktDrawTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawTests.cpp#L103-L120)).

## Verification Methods

- **Color buffer**: CPU reference generation encodes the expected stored value, maximum instance index, and layer/view
  index into an integer color pixel ([`vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1314-L1376)).
  The rendered color image is compared with `tcu::intThresholdCompare()` using a zero threshold
  ([`vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1383-L1385)).
- **Stencil buffer**: the reference stencil value is `(instanceCount * stencilIncrements) % 256`, matching
  increment-and-wrap behavior ([`vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1371-L1372)).
  The rendered stencil image is compared with `tcu::dsThresholdCompare()` using threshold `0.0`
  ([`vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1387-L1388)).
- **Stride and indexing semantics**: reference generation handles no-instance/no-draw cases, stride-zero repetition,
  indexed draw reversal, mixed indexed offsets, and overlapping-depth behavior before comparison
  ([`vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1321-L1364)).

## Notes

- The source registration has no direct `draw.dynamic_rendering.multi_draw` placement; dynamic-rendering multi-draw cases are nested under command-buffer mode groups.
- For draw counts greater than one, generated cases with a stride smaller than the base structure size or not aligned to
  four bytes are skipped to avoid the listed multi-draw VUID violations
  ([`vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1571-L1579)).
- Overlapping meshes skip instanced drawing when `instanceCount > 1`
  ([`vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L1582-L1585)).
- The `DrawInfoPacker` helper computes structure sizes, handles stride-zero storage, and adds padding for packed indexed
  draws ([`vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawMultiExtTests.cpp#L245-L334)).
